plan.notes: Source: Queens College Academic Advising Center (AAC) official 'Computer Science BS - FOUR-YEAR ACADEMIC PLAN' PDF, https://www.qc.cuny.edu/aac/wp-content/uploads/sites/84/2025/08/Computer-Science-BS.pdf. Catalog year 2025-2026: the plan states it is 'for freshmen entering Queens College in Fall 2025'. Transcription method: manual transcription of the term-by-term grid by the data collector; term totals copied verbatim from the PDF (16/16/16/15/16/15/15/16). Credit total 125 = sum of the official term totals. Caveats: (1) The AAC calls these plans 'illustrative examples of integrated degree requirements'; students are advised to meet advisors to tailor the map. (2) General-education slots are choice slots - specific courses vary by student and semester; areas named exactly as in the PDF. (3) The seven CS electives must be CSCI 300-396 courses with the substitution rules quoted in the Junior Spring elective note. (4) Per-course prerequisites are not printed in the 4-year plan and are left empty; the plan states prerequisites/co-requisites are strictly enforced. (5) MATH 120 note: the department substitutes CSCI 120 for MATH 120. (6) Credential check: Queens College officially offers BOTH a Computer Science BS and a Computer Science BA (see https://cs.qc.cuny.edu/index-1.html). This file covers the BS.
